endorsements.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Device Software Functions: Lifecycle Management and Marketing Submission Recommendations (draft guidance)
endorsements.quote: For example, if there is an application 425 for patients, an application for caregivers, and a data portal for healthcare providers, the device 426 description should include details on all functions across the applications and address how they 427 are connected.

endorsements.title: A deployment safety case for AI-assisted prostate cancer diagnosis
endorsements.quote: The first step in our methodology, illustrated in Fig. 2 , is to map out the clinical workflow in which the medical device is intended to be deployed.

endorsements.title: AI as Core Infrastructure in Radiology: Moving Beyond Pilots to Operational Excellence
endorsements.issuer: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
endorsements.quote: A practical call to action is therefore not to pretend every integration can be standard on day one, but to standardise the integration process: common interface intake, reusable routing patterns, consistent logging, downtime procedures, cybersecurity review, and documentation of where AI output enters the clinical workflow.

commentary.bottom_line: No supplied study tests whether developer documentation of intended workflow, workflow phase, interface sequence, and output incorporation reduces misuse or ignored outputs at deploying sites. The recommendation currently rests on one FDA draft guidance and one safety-case commentary.

perspectives.view: The evidence base contains zero studies that test the practice and zero studies that document the hazard. Both endorsements are expert opinion, one in draft regulatory guidance and one in a commentary. Under GRADE conventions, no certainty rating can be assigned to the effect of workflow documentation on misuse or ignored outputs.

FDA draft guidance on AI-enabled device software functions states that the device description should cover all functions across connected applications for patients, caregivers, and providers and explain how they connect. Because the guidance is a draft, it signals agency expectations for marketing submissions but does not yet carry final status.

A deployment safety case for AI-assisted prostate cancer diagnosis names mapping the intended clinical workflow as the first step of its method. This places workflow documentation at the start of hazard analysis, but the commentary does not report whether the step caught errors before they reached patients.

commentary.research_gap: Studies should compare sites that receive structured developer workflow documentation with sites that do not, and measure off-label workflow use, rates of ignored or overridden outputs, and downstream patient harm. Researchers should also study documentation fidelity and the effort required for sites to map vendor workflows onto local practice.
commentary.underserved_note: No study tested the practice, so no evidence covers Medicaid, safety-net, limited English proficiency, or low-literacy populations. Safety-net sites often run workflows that differ from those at developer partner sites, and whether workflow documentation helps them adapt tools safely remains unknown.
